'''Magravia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Magravia system/Legends|Magravia system]],<ref name="TEA" /> a part of the [[Karthakk sector/Legends|Karthakk sector]]<ref name="EAOC Magravia" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was situated on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Llanic Spice Run/Legends|Llanic Spice Run]], which connected it to the [[Llanic system/Legends|Llanic system]] as well as the [[Socorro system/Legends|Socorro system]]<ref name="TEA" /> in the [[Kibilini sector/Legends|Kibilini sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

Magravia was a notable [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-production site,<ref name="TEA" /> being the origin point of the spice variant known as the [[Magravian cat-spice]].<ref name="Hunted" /><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Magravian cat-spice]]|system=[[Magravia system/Legends|Magravia system]], and specifically Magravia|legends=1}}</ref> As a result, the world was well-known to [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Magravia was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-17.<ref name="TEA" />
